comparison.objective: Segregate incompatible cleaning chemicals into separate cabinet bays.
comparison.physical_skill: Semantic sorting, container transport, and cabinet placement rather than damper adjustment and tool-mediated locking.
comparison.success_condition: Incompatible chemicals occupy separate bays versus two safe repeatable carriage stops without drift or damage. Exact separation/scoring thresholds are not included.
comparison.reason: Chemical segregation tests storage reasoning and placement, not fine maintenance manipulation or impact-response control.
